scope: Preimplementation card review; no importer code yet

issues.title: Asset metadata binding absent from explicit importer checks
issues.goal: Saved Asset describes exact retained original bytes (LOCAL_WRITE_CONTRACT/BANK_TYPES_R1)
issues.mechanism: Q1 recommends pure validate_documents. Its schema/ref checks accept Asset sha256=zero while package retains another hash; without an explicit inventory bind importer can save a broken Asset even with valid transport hashes.
issues.example: Mutant Asset document/manifest/READY rehashed consistently: pure helper PASS, full static package reference ASSET_DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH.
issues.impact: Main original-byte semantics; card coverage gap, no implemented importer defect claimed
issues.resolution: DB2/DB6 explicitly require Asset file_path/length/hash inventory and retained mapping checks

issues.title: Replay must precede new-command duplicate/history validation, not just CAS
issues.goal: Exact retry after timeout returns original acceptance without duplicate revisions (LW02)
issues.mechanism: Calling recommended pure helper against accepted history before exact replay lookup rejects original revisions as DUPLICATE_REVISION. Card previously ordered only replay before CAS, leaving the new-domain helper branch ambiguous.
issues.impact: Main retry/recovery behavior if implemented with the suggested naive pipeline
issues.resolution: Explicit sequence/DB3 isolate verified stored replay from new-command domain/history/duplicate checks

issues.title: Incoming limits do not bound complete accepted-history recursion/materialization
issues.goal: Finite local importer work and retained history, no arbitrary crash as Bank grows
issues.mechanism: Recommended helper builds an index over all accepted documents and recursively traverses their causal graph. Incoming 128-op/byte caps do not constrain historical document count or causal depth.
issues.example: One incoming independent document + valid newest-first 1100-document accepted chain => RecursionError.
issues.impact: Main continued use, affects importer built by unbounded helper reuse; not a user-data experiment
issues.resolution: Targeted indexed history adapter and iterative current-package graph strategy; DB8 growth/long-chain and bounded-BLOB tests required

issues.title: R1 intent boundary missing from explicit domain gate
issues.goal: R1 independent save; tracked research/RunSpec semantics delivered in R2
issues.mechanism: Transport enum and static helper permit tracked_research with four valid R1 documents; card had no explicit intent rejection even though full research-domain contract is absent in R1.
issues.example: Static validate_package(profile=R1) accepts tracked_research command, 4 documents.
issues.impact: Scope/meaning of acceptance, can pretend research command was fully validated
issues.resolution: DB2 explicit independent_save-only R1 and rejection of tracked_research/Source/Run; no scope extension or invented Run

uncertainties.note: Defensive mode and SQL immutable trigger still allow intentional trusted-connection blobopen write to existing bytes. Not an incoming exploitable SQL or schema defect by itself. Application must confine writes to new active-command rows, with DB4/DB6 evidence.

uncertainties.item: Canonical receipt versus client pending/unknown/fault outcome
